A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same 24-page ALMI paper, including Appendices A–E. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection establish matching content without material gaps; the only visible difference is the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v1 reports original simulation comparisons and ablations in Tables 2–3, foundation-model experiments in Appendix D, and real-robot demonstrations in Section 6.3 and Appendix E.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original simulation results, ablations, foundation-model experiments, and real-robot demonstrations in Tables 2–3 and Appendices D–E.

M1.justification: Sections 3–4 and Appendices B/D retain identical adversarial updates, curricula, policy components, rewards, and foundation-model training and inference procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same AMASS motions, CMU evaluation data, ALMI-X dataset, and Unitree H1-2 simulation and real-world locomotion, motion-tracking, and loco-manipulation scenarios.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains Exbody and ALMI(whole). The comparator variants in Table 3 and the CL-20sl, CL-400sl, and OL comparisons in Appendix D are also identical.

E3.justification: The 1,122-clip CMU evaluation, Table 1 difficulty settings, evaluation metrics, training settings, and Appendix D foundation-model testing procedures are unchanged.

E4.justification: Table 3 retains the same adversarial-iteration and arm-curriculum ablations. Appendix D's sequence-length and control-mode analyses and the supplementary data analyses and robot demonstrations are unchanged.

E5.justification: Appendix D specifies five repetitions per command in both versions. Neither version adds or changes seed information, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance testing.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings match, including Tables 2–3 and 11–12 and the appendix demonstrations. For example, ALMI's hard-setting survival rate remains 0.9723 in Table 2.

T1.justification: The Markov-game formulation, Theorem 3.1, Appendix A's assumptions and proof, and the remaining mathematical definitions and derivations are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about ALMI's coordinated control, the ALMI-X dataset, and preliminary language-guided foundation-model learning.

C2.justification: Both versions retain the same robustness interpretations and qualifications, including reduced motion expressiveness in Section 5 and difficulty scaling foundation-model training to the complete ALMI-X dataset in Section 6.2 and Appendix D.

D1.justification: Appendices B–E retain identical implementation details, hyperparameters, domain randomization, data collection instructions, and deployment hardware. The project and dataset access links are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 5, the comparisons with prior research elsewhere, and all 73 references are unchanged. Neither version adds citations or revises novelty positioning.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from 'v1, 19 Apr 2025' to 'v2, 3 Jun 2025'. This is a limited administrative text update; all paper prose, headings, terminology, and section ordering remain identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–10, Tables 1–12, captions, and page layout are unchanged. Rendered pages 2–24 are pixel-identical, and page 1 differs only in the version/date text.

improvement.justification: The main text and appendices retain identical scientific content, evidence, explanations, limitations, and substantive presentation. Updating the arXiv version/date stamp and its corresponding link produces no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
